rows.text: This mannequin is covered in dimmed patterns. It has obviously been left here for a long while. At the moment you touched it, streams of light radiated once more.

Without the pull of the golden thread, the mannequin sputters incomprehensible phrases. The voice sounds a bit like Aglaea, but there is also a subtle difference, as if an over-copied version of Clockie Season 1.
The mannequin fell silent once more. However, the radiance on its surface didn't dissipate. Perhaps you managed to fix it.
The sunlight has not yet faded from Janusopolis... How charming it is. Thanks to you, I'm able to witness this view with my own eyes.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: Pity. I am but a Garmentmaker, not Lady Aglaea herself. Were she here, she'd surely have more to say.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: I apologize if I startled you, dear guest. It wasn't intentional... Compared to other Garmentmakers, I have indeed been imbued with a greater degree of soul essence.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: This place is far too removed from the era we once lived in. Even Lady Aglaea's golden threads cannot reach it. To better fulfill my tasks, I must possess autonomous judgment.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: Aside from myself, other Garmentmakers have also received this blessing — the Scribe Garmentmaker for instance. We inherited certain talents from Lady Aglaea...
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: Ah, it seems I've said too much. Let us return to the matter at hand, dear guest.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker
